A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-comscandetection-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[ComScan Detection]] (Decipher, November 1996): The game text now reads: “If opponent just moved a character, vehicle or starship as a ‘react’ to a location, you may immediately move one vehicle or starship, if within range, to that location (as a regular move).” The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Comscan Detection” and a white italic “E”. The slip misprints the card type as “USE INTERRUPT” (the card is a Used Interrupt) and spells the title “Comscan”.

The lower part of the earlier card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
